findings.label: Plan/impl drift on computeStoredPlayerAccuracy
findings.detail: The plan specified reimplementing computeStoredPlayerAccuracy as a thin wrapper, but the implementation removed it entirely. It was a module-local function with no external callers (zero remaining references in the worktree), so removal is a clean simplification and is recorded in the verification doc. No action required.

findings.label: analystWindow single-file null behavior
findings.detail: The compare page's analystWindow memo now returns null when either master or analyst is absent, whereas the old code derived a window from whichever single side had instances. This only affects the manual-range input placeholder when exactly one file is loaded (a state with no gradeable comparison, since canonical/grading memos require both). Cosmetic, not a live-view grading regression.
